```artifact
Feature: System Backup and User Authentication

  Scenario: Nightly Backup Rotation
  Given the system is operational at the end of the day
  When the backup process is initiated
  Then the backup should be completed and sent to the remote site
  And the backup rotation should be set for 30 days from the current date

  Scenario Outline: Backup Rotation Examples
    | Backup Date       | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Today + 30 days> | Backup is successfully rotated and stored remotely |
    | <Today + 29 days> | Backup is pending rotation, not yet stored remotely |
    | <Today + 1 day>  | Backup is overdue, rotation failed                 |

  Scenario: User Password Change
  Given a user is logged in with valid credentials
  When the user requests to change their password
  Then the password change should be processed
  And the user should be able to log in with the new credentials

  Scenario Outline: Password Change Examples
    | New Password | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Valid Password> | Password change is successful, user can log in |
    | <Invalid Password> | Password change fails, user cannot log in |

  Scenario: Patient Registration and User-id Creation
  Given a patient is registering for the first time
  When the patient is prompted to create a user-id and password
  Then the user-id and password should be created
  And the patient should be able to log in with the new credentials

  Scenario Outline: User-id Creation Examples
    | User-id and Password | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Valid User-id and Password> | User-id and password creation is successful, patient can log in |
    | <Invalid User-id and Password> | User-id and password creation fails, patient cannot log in |

  Scenario: Doctor Appointment Report Generation
  Given it is the last day of the month
  When the system generates the doctor appointment report
  Then the report should contain appointments for the next 5 days

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Appointment Report Examples
    | Report Content | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Valid Appointments> | Report contains valid appointments for the next 5 days |
    | <Invalid Appointments> | Report contains invalid appointments for the next 5 days |

  Scenario: Speciality Consultation Report Generation
  Given it is the last day of the month
  When the system generates the speciality consultation report
  Then the report should contain consultations for the current month/quarter/year

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Consultation Report Examples
    | Report Content | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Valid Consultations> | Report contains valid consultations for the current month/quarter/year |
    | <Invalid Consultations> | Report contains invalid consultations for the current month/quarter/year |

  Scenario: Speciality Revenue Report Generation
  Given it is the last day of the month
  When the system generates the speciality revenue report
  Then the report should contain revenue for the current month/quarter/year

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Revenue Report Examples
    | Report Content | Expected Result                                  |
    | <Valid Revenue> | Report contains valid revenue for the current month/quarter/year |
    | <Invalid Revenue> | Report contains invalid revenue for the current month/quarter/year |
```
